description: Remote config keys apps understand. Types: bool, number, string, string_array, version (a string in the versions.json format). Apps ignore unknown keys and wrongly typed values, keeping the default. null means no value.

feed.enabled.doc: Kill switch for the social feed tab.

feed.page_size.doc: Posts per page for Latest, Following, profile and play-along lists (Discover is fixed at 24). Read once per launch.

default: Every scale — modes, harmonic minor, exotic

store.pro_note.doc: Optional line under the Pro bullets. Hidden when empty. Never a price.

update.minimum_version.doc: Older versions are blocked with an App Store button.

update.recommended_version.doc: Older versions see a dismissible update banner.

update.message.doc: Optional text on the update banner and blocker.

update.app_store_url.doc: Update button target. Must start with https://apps.apple.com/.

instruments.remote_enabled.doc: Show downloaded instruments and fetch the catalog.
